components.purpose: Full-width opening banner at the top of the page — supports a Heading, Description, and two separate CTA link fields (cta1, cta2) for the two buttons, plus a full-bleed gradient/background image.
Customer logos section — a simple nested grid of logo items, ideal for showcasing customer/partner logos without personalization logic.
Features grid with screenshots — subheading/heading plus a grid of Bento cards, each with a required 'Graphic' image, explicitly intended for showcasing screenshots or product graphics.
Three key stats — centered heading/description above a single row of stat tiles (value + label), a clean fit for exactly a few key numbers.
One customer quote — pulls a single testimonial item from the shared Testimonials list (as opposed to the Testimonials component, which renders a whole list).
Final contact form — dedicated contact form component with heading, description, submit URL, and contact details fields to close out the page.
